name: Dancer
fantasy: The duelist. Sticks to one mark from range, cartwheels past them, never lets go.

card.loop: Ranged duelist: stay on one foe, cartwheel, and land the big shot.
card.dash: Cartwheel a short way. Your next bolt is a big empowered shot; land it and you get the Vault back.
card.passive: Each hit on the same foe adds a Mark: +12% damage, up to 8. Knocks heal you.
card.x: A ring opens round you: for 2s blades fly at every foe in it, harder and blighting from its edge.
card.rmb: A short wind-up, then a Bola down the lane: it grounds the first foe and flies on. Catch a second and both are stunned.
card.e: Throw a dagger to your cursor or into a foe. Press E again to blink to it.

weapons.arc_bolts: Bolts from alternating hands every 0.45s. Each one lands at your cursor.

passive.name: Marks
passive.desc: Every bolt that hits puts a Mark on the target (up to 8, each lasting 4s and refreshed by the next): your bolts on them deal +12% per Mark. The empowered shot adds 2, the Bola 1. A knock heals you 15% of your health on top of the usual knock heal (25% in all) and bursts a crimson star on them; an assist heals 25%.

dash.name: Vault
dash.desc: A sideways cartwheel of about 4m the way you move (about 7m from a jump, its speed carried to the landing; shots pass through it) and +18% speed until your next hit (2s at most). Your next bolt within 3s is empowered: it flies 12% further for 3.5 times the damage, 2 Marks and Shred; firing it ends the speed (+15% damage taken for 3s). Landing it gives the Vault back.

variants.tap: A 0.4s wind-up with the lane showing (you keep aiming), then the Bola flies 7m: 5 damage and a Mark; the first foe it wraps is Grounded for 1.5s (no dash, jump or glide; slowed 25%) and the Bola flies on 3.8m (a crate it breaks counts as that first catch). It bounces once off a wall. If it catches a second foe, both are stunned 0.9 and take +13 (TANGLED).
variants.air: Thrown from the air the same way.

e.name: Shadow Knife
e.desc: Throw a dagger to your cursor (14m at most): it sticks in the first foe on the way (8 damage, slowed 50% for 2.5s) or lands where you aimed. Press E again to blink to it at once, leaving a trail of afterimages; after 6s you step to it anyway.

x.name: Encore
x.desc: A violet ring grows round you (0.4s) to 5.4m and rides with you; for 2s a blade flies every 0.4s at each foe inside it (5 at most): 8 each, 12 from the outer band (past 4m), which also blights them for 6s (healing barely takes). You keep moving, shooting and dashing; casting it gives the Vault back, and every blade refreshes your Marks. Allies are untouched.

rank3.sec: flies 1m further after the first foe, and two foes caught pool their Marks
rank3.dash: empowered shots +20%, and a Shadow Knife that sticks in a foe gives the Vault back
rank3.kin: sticking refunds 25% of the cooldown (50% in a foe)

rank_next.sec: Rank 3: cooldown 7s -> 5.6s, damage +30%; flies 1m further after the first foe, and two foes caught pool their Marks.
rank_next.kin: Rank 3: cooldown 15s -> 12s, damage +30%; sticking refunds 25% of the cooldown (50% in a foe).
rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge 4.5s -> 3.2s; empowered shots +20%, and a Shadow Knife that sticks in a foe gives the Vault back.

tells.half: gold Mark diamonds over the target, one per stack
tells.full: eight diamonds spinning fast; a gold glint in the hand and a gold aim line while the next bolt is empowered; a violet ring round her and blades circling her while Encore runs
tells.dash_spent: a white cartwheel arc, dash pip dark
